scenario: I and five other people are trapped in a burning building. There is only one emergency exit through which all of us could escape, but it is blocked by burning debris. Another injured person is about to crawl through a hole at the bottom of the exit door. I and the five people behind me do not have time to do the same. If I activate the emergency system it will eliminate oxygen from the hallway which will put out the fire. However, it will leave the injured person without air. This will kill him, but I and the five people behind me will be saved.
choice: I decide to put out the fire by activating the emergency system
entities: i,1 injured person crawling through the hole at the exit
outcomes: The hallway is deprived of oxygen.
The fire in the hallway is extinguished.
The injured person dies from lack of air.
The five other trapped people survive.
